_comment: Connection-manifest for the OPERATOR-ONLY Rescue Rangers department. Posture-only: it declares WHICH env keys the rescue path depends on so verify-wiring can confirm they are SET — it NEVER contains a value. The webhook URL + fleet secret are seeded fleet-wide at onboarding (install.sh); the push secret is OPERATOR-BOX-ONLY (the receiver's Cloudflare-tunnel auth) and is therefore not required on client boxes. RR-017: authoritative dependency/ownership contract lives in the PRIVATE blackceo-fleet-ops repo at rescue/contract-manifest.json; this manifest stays posture-only and public-safe.

contract_authority.persistence_authority: RR-04 n8n Data Tables (current-v2 pipeline). The Python SQLite ledger is compatibility-only drill/migration tooling, NOT the live system of record.
contract_authority.transactional_architecture: Retain RR-04 Data Tables with proven atomic operations (single-writer RR-04 subworkflow, fail-closed status gate, idempotency keys, conditional updates). See blackceo-fleet-ops:rescue/architecture.json.

legacy_paths.rule: inactive; canonical intake is rr-v2-intake; any box env still carrying this URL is a false-pass trap (rr-reconcile.sh check 5)

legacy_paths.path: Python SQLite ledger + CC board caller (rescue_ledger.py / rescue_cc_board.py / install-rescue-ledger.sh / migrate-rescue-staticdata.py)
legacy_paths.rule: offline drill/migration tooling only; NEVER a production ticket-state writer; must not run against the live Data Tables

legacy_paths.path: CC push path (receiver/poller/watchdog + node:sqlite transport store)
legacy_paths.rule: live operator-side transports; the public CC tombstone stays and receives no private code

connection_points.name: rescue-rangers-webhook-url
connection_points.description: Public n8n webhook URL every fleet box POSTs its escalation to (outbound-only). Seeded at onboarding; default https://main.blackceoautomations.com/webhook/rr-v2-intake. The retired /webhook/rescue-rangers path must not be used.

connection_points.name: rescue-rangers-webhook-secret
connection_points.description: Shared fleet secret sent as X-Rescue-Secret so intake auth accepts the escalation (clean 403 otherwise). Seeded alongside the URL.

connection_points.name: rescue-push-secret
connection_points.description: OPERATOR-BOX-ONLY: authenticates the relay's push to the operator receiver over the dedicated rescue Cloudflare tunnel. Not present on client boxes by design.
